map_plan_note: After-only optional diagnostics aggregate preparation+measurement publications. fallback_counts: global, exhausted overflow, exhausted underflow, resource. local_cost_counts: less/equal/more nodes than the same-work current bulk reference. Counts can overlap and are observations, not correctness assertions. Planning interval starts at first publisher backing read and ends at first replacement-write callback; includes adapter reads and reference-count diagnostics, excludes earlier planning. No production clock dependency.
timing_note: After instrumented diagnostics are included in elapsed times; there is no uninstrumented after timing sample or separate counting timer. RAM loop/callback timing is not NVMe performance. Native after_end_seconds includes verification, process handoff and teardown.
scope: Unchanged 40-case matrix, four configured workloads, populations32/256, Pyxis individually durable only; native individually durable and16-operation batch boundaries. All trailing maintenance/final synchronization included; initialization/preparation are separately recorded. No large campaigns or budgets changed.
